title: Pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body, angled diagonally -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <!-- wooden shaft -->
    <rect x='40' y='18' width='20' height='52' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <!-- lighter highlight on shaft -->
    <rect x='40' y='18' width='6' height='52' fill='#ffdf8a'/>
    <!-- pink eraser -->
    <rect x='40' y='10' width='20' height='9' rx='3' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
    <!-- eraser highlight -->
    <rect x='40' y='11' width='5' height='7' rx='2' fill='#ffc2cd'/>
    <!-- metal ferrule -->
    <rect x='40' y='18.5' width='20' height='7' fill='#c9d6df'/>
    <rect x='40' y='18.5' width='20' height='2.5' fill='#eef4f8'/>
    <rect x='40' y='22.5' width='20' height='2' fill='#9fb3c0'/>
    <!-- wood cone to tip -->
    <polygon points='40,70 60,70 50,90' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <polygon points='40,70 50,70 50,90' fill='#d9a43a'/>
    <!-- graphite tip -->
    <polygon points='45.5,83 54.5,83 50,90' fill='#8b7fd4'/>
    <!-- graphite shine -->
    <polygon points='47.5,83 50,83 50,87' fill='#b8b0e8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
